item.title: Escape from Ever After PS5 Review | Thumb Culture
item.description: Have you ever asked yourself, What would you get if you mixed fairy tales, paper-thin characters (literally), and a charming, colourful aesthetic? No, me neither, but thankfully developer Sleepy Castle Studio did, because now we have Escape from Ever After!

item.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics Review From The Top With Gusto - Pixelbytegaming
item.description: Ys X: Proud Nordics remains the great game that was released in 2024. If you have yet to play the game, it is an easy title to recommend. If you have already played it, the additional content might not add enough bang for your buck.

item.title: Shutaro Iida (Castlevania, Bloodstained) Passes Away After Battle with Cancer
item.description: The gaming world mourns Shutaro Iida, the visionary director of Bloodstained and Castlevania. He passed away on Feb 10 after a battle with cancer.

item.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics Review | The Outerhaven
item.description: The Outerhaven writes: We break down the new story content, gameplay updates, and whether this enhanced re-release is worth the upgrade.

item.title: "God Of War: Sons Of Sparta" Review: The Kid Is Alright \\ paulsemel
item.description: "God Of War: Sons Of Sparta" is exactly what you think it's going to be ... if you think it's going to be a first-rate side-scrolling action game version of God Of War.

item.title: Cairn Review: Survive the Climb | The Outerhaven
item.description: The Outerhaven writes: Cairn equally delivers in both its touching narrative and challenging mountain climbing as well.

item.title: God of War Sons of Sparta Review | XboxEra
item.description: God of War Sons of Sparta takes the iconic series and gives us a 2D Metroidvania prequel. You will play as Kratos in his teenage years. He and his brother Deimos are Spartans training to become soldiers.

item.title: Ys X: Proud Nordics Review
item.description: Ben of Netto's Game Room reviews Ys X: Proud Nordics, the enhanced version of the original Ys X, and possibly one of the best entries in the series.

item.title: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery Review | The Outerhaven
item.description: Help transform a band of misfits in Calamity Angels: Special Delivery from a rookie mess-up team into a punctual, powerful delivery team.

item.title: Under the Island Review 2D Zelda-like With a Hockey Stick | Console Creatures
item.description: Console Creatures writes, "Under the Island wears its 2D Zelda inspiration proudly on its sleeve and pulls it off exceptionally well, with a great game and stunning modern pixel graphics that feel like Saturday-morning cartoons from the '90s."
